disposition_reason: Source-native rebinding identifies an ordered original task: Bayesian position decoding evaluated by Fig. 1D RMSE across all animals/sessions and original arm conditions. The exact numerical source baseline, evaluation identities, split and reduction are not recovered, so the task is not admitted. Descriptive sequence/replay reconstruction remains calibration.

source_paper.title: Formation of task representations and replay in mouse medial prefrontal cortex

evidence.locator: Figs. 4–6; Methods: Burst detection, Clustering sequences, Bayesian decoder, Position estimation
evidence.supports: Defines biological sequence formation and replay, source burst/clustering procedure and distinct positional decoding analysis.
Identifies the derived PFC neural/behavioral/mask data and separate raw-data deposit.

evidence.supports: Documents clustering/replay analysis chain and the separate Figure 1 decoding-error notebook.

evidence.locator: Results: Task coding in mPFC; Fig. 1C–D and Fig. 5I; Methods: Bayesian decoder, Position estimation, Estimate position using burst data
evidence.supports: An authentic original position-prediction RMSE route exists; Fig. 1D covers all animals/sessions, while Methods describe exclusion of bursts/neighbors or detected sequences from fitting and burst testing.

target.description: Predict true goal-arm-specific spatial position from the recorded neural population; preserve the complete source Fig. 1D direct and cross-decoding conditions.

dataset.description: Original longitudinal mPFC calcium/behavior data are linked through G-Node DOI 10.12751/g-node.b8k1yn and raw-data Zenodo 10528244. Exact files carrying Fig. 1D activity, true positions and session masks require binding.

cohort.description: Fig. 1D includes all animals and sessions in the source analysis. Four-mouse biological identity, session inclusion and inconsistent displayed/file IDs must be reconciled before freezing that roster.

split.description: Source Methods exclude burst/neighbor or detected-sequence timepoints from rate-map fitting and assess burst signals. The exact Fig. 1D training/test timepoints and cross-arm mappings must be recovered rather than inferred from Fig. 5I or replaced with a new split.

inputs.description: Population calcium-transient counts and training rate maps derived from source activity/behavior; true assessment positions are evaluator targets, not candidate inputs.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source transient detection, occupancy/rate-map construction, bin duration, position coordinate normalization and exclusion masks. Methods specify a Poisson decoder, but exact Fig. 1D notebook settings and native conversion remain unbound.

metric.description: RMSE is sqrt(mean((predicted_position-true_position)^2)); lower is better. Source position units/normalization, accepted bins and treatment of undefined predictions must be recovered for exact comparability.

aggregation.description: Retain every source animal/session and left/right direct/cross-decoding stratum in Fig. 1D. The exact source reduction and a defensible joint superiority rule are not yet fixed; no favorable stratum or new macro mean may substitute.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Fig. 1D position-decoding RMSE, with source cohort/arm-condition aggregation pending

published_baseline.description: Fig. 1D reports RMSE distributions; the text describes about 0.2 for the Fig. 5I median and similarity to Fig. 1D. That approximation is not an exact Fig. 1D baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author README identifies Estimate_place_code_error.ipynb for Fig. 1; exact source inputs, native notebook settings and an independently verified rerun remain missing.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful RMSE reduction must be justified in the original coordinate units and against source measurement variability; no numeric margin is invented.

uncertainty.method: No superiority rule is admitted until original evaluation identities and paired baseline outputs are recovered.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse, with paired sessions/trials and timepoints nested within mouse.
uncertainty.rationale: Four animals and temporal dependence preclude treating frames as independent replication; paired source baseline outputs and complete source strata are needed.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact source activity/behavior files, all-animal/all-session roster, arm mappings, original exclusions and Fig. 1D aggregation.
Compare a frozen candidate against the original author decoder under identical input access and split; retain every source direct/cross-decoding condition.
Recover an exact source result or reproduce the source-authorized decoder; an approximate plotted or textual RMSE is insufficient.
Predeclare meaningful effect, paired uncertainty and resource/access budgets before final scoring.
A new trial split or local template-recurrence score is an extension, not evidence of surpassing this source prediction task.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparator is distinct from an author rerun and from current SOTA; no current-SOTA comparison was verified.

episode.improvement_loop: After original binding, allow iteration only on source-authorized development observations; keep final position targets evaluator-owned.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze method, dependencies, preprocessing, tuning history and all source condition predictions before final evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Replay the exact Fig. 1D position task on every original evaluation stratum, compare paired RMSE with the recovered author baseline, and apply a predeclared joint rule.
episode.baseline_policy: Use the source Fig. 1D author decoder; preserve Fig. 5I as its distinct original burst analysis. Local recurrence and shuffled controls are not paper baselines.

blocking_issues: Exact Fig. 1D source numerical baseline and original reduction are unresolved.
Activity/behavior files, animal/session identities, coordinate units and split/exclusion mappings must be bound.
No validated original-task evaluator, author rerun, justified margin, uncertainty rule or concrete episode budgets are admitted.

legacy.notes: Preserve the historical sequence-selectivity/replay reconstruction and prospective template-recurrence component as calibration/extension assets. Current source-native objective is position prediction; the local Poisson kernel has not yet been qualified as the original Fig. 1D evaluator.
